notes: Qinghu profile 0.1.1: benign API skill; narrow and relocate traits
qhkit 0.14.0: benign API CLI; fix form and metadata false matches
behavior: Skill requests a WeChat Channels account profile via paid Qinghu MCP tools.
Node CLI dispatches only bundled local command modules, has no install hooks or dependencies.
Credentials come from explicit env/user/Qinghu config; authenticated requests target configured Qinghu domains.
Media uploads use user supplied paths; large MCP results and catalogs are cached under .qhkit.
Version check fetches registry metadata and prints an upgrade command; it does not execute that command.
UUIDs generate request IDs; media parsing does not execute downloaded code.
rule_changes: Move Node artifact evidence out of dropper objectives; require a versioned runtime archive name.
Move add/install commands into package-manager capability; global installation does not imply project dependency addition.
Move and narrow SCHEMA/TARGET initializer observations into source declaration metadata; timeout constants do not establish schema data.
Require a direct package-named argument to JSON.stringify; translationTypes: pkg.code is unrelated.
Retain form-named member access as a neutral property observation; browser composite requires separate DOM evidence.
Correct hidden temp entry and compressed tar path descriptions.
scope: Judgments cover inspected bytes only; unpinned future installs are not covered.
